title: Blue Iris Alert Motion Score Leaderboard
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=blueiris:event motion_score=*
| stats sum(motion_score) as total_value, avg(motion_score) as avg_value by camera_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks camera values by total and average motion score across Blue Iris alert events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `motion_score` values for each Blue Iris alert event and review total and average motion score by camera.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total motion score.
grandmaExplanation: It scores which camera shows the biggest motion score numbers in your Blue Iris alert data.
